Timex's mid-century Marlin gets a Space Age update in the Marlin Jet, with a domed Hesalite acrylic crystal that covers the whole top of the watch, bezel included. This version has a titanium case that is noticeably lighter than steel and a red-and-white GMT hand for a second time zone, set independently of the hour hand. The 40mm case is paired with a black leather strap that swaps without tools. The watch is water resistant to 164 feet, enough for a shower or a light swim but not for diving.

The Société d'Exploitation de la Tour Eiffel collaborated with A+A Cooren Design Studio and Lagardère x Arteum (LxA) to create a collector's lamp drawing from Gustave Eiffel's original tower blueprints while preserving traces of weathered patina from the bulb's life 1,000 feet above Paris. entry.content:
The Land Rover 101 Forward Control was designed in the Cold War for one job: hauling the British Army's L118 Light Gun, plus a ton of shells and kit, over any terrain. The Army is said to have wanted a truck small enough to fly in a cargo plane, so engineers placed the cab over the front axle, tucked a 3.5-liter Rover V8 behind it, and named the truck for its 101-inch wheelbase. Locking differentials and four-wheel drive pulled it through mud, the body panels reportedly came off for helicopter lifts, and some chassis ended up as ambulances and radio trucks. About 2,650 were built by 1978 and many served into the 1990s. Private buyers could get them only as military surplus, and civilians today drive them as survival trucks, like this 1977 truck, which sold at auction.

The wider La Marzocco x Porsche collection includes a matching Pico grinder, espresso and cappuccino cups, a coffee tin, hoodies and a 1:18-scale Carrera model car.

entry.content:
Norman Foster, the Pritzker Prize-winning architect behind London's Gherkin, Apple Park and the Reichstag dome in Berlin, designed his first watch at 91 with the Swiss maker Lebond. A pilot with a long history of travel, he gave it a bezel that rotates both ways to track a second time zone. Foster chose Grade 5 titanium for the 38.5mm case to cut weight without losing strength. He also removed the lugs, the arms that normally hold a strap, so the case and the light grey rubber strap read as one continuous shape around the wrist. A custom blue rotor, the part that winds the watch, shows through the sapphire caseback. Each case is individually numbered.
